items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: Because I had, we had, uh, Smitty, remember Smitty died piano player? Yeah. He was on there.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. And, uh, I don't know what happened, whether it was financial or what, but I know he's able now, but I don't know what happened with that, if you understand. But, uh, we made some nice records. Because I had, we had, uh, Smitty, remember Smitty died piano player? Yeah. He was on there. And, uh, Anderson, trumpet player. Mm-hmm. And, uh, several other guys that was on there that we made the records.
Do you remember the tunes that y'all put up, were gonna have a record? The what? The tunes that y'all were, uh, recalling. Oh, yeah, yeah. Uh-huh.
